text.en:
Creation of an Inter-Agency Council. The Inter-Agency Council on
the IMSAS (Council) is hereby created, to be composed of the Secretary of the
Department of Transportation (DOT) as Chairperson and the Administrator of the
Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA) as Vice Chairperson, and representatives from the
Department of Foreign Affairs, Philippine Coast Guard, Philippine Ports Authority and
Cebu Port Authority, as members.

Functions of the Council. The Council shall ensure that its member-
agencies shall implement and comply with all the policies, laws and issuances pertaining
to the implementation of the IMO instruments in an integrated manner. Towards this end,
the Council shall have the following functions:
Effectively and carefully plan, manage and monitor the efforts of national
government agencies and instrumentalities involved in the implementation of
applicable IMO instruments pertaining to: (i) safety of life at sea; (il) prevention
of pollution from ships; (i) standards of training, certification and watchkeeping

for seafarers; (iv) load lines; (v) tonnage measurement of ships; and (vi)
regulations for preventing collisions at sea;
Ensure the adoption of rules and regulations implementing the provisions,
requirements and technical annexes of applicable international instruments, as
well as future amendments thereto;
Review, approve and implement a National Work Programme (NWP) as
defined under Section 3 of this Order, as well as adopt mechanisms to ensure
that international obligations and responsibilities of the Philippines as a flag,
port and coastal State are fully satisfied; and
d. Perform such other functions as may be directed by the President.

Creation of a Technical Working Group (TWG). The Council shall be
assisted by a TWG responsible for providing technical support on specific subjects of the
IMSAS, to be composed of the following:
Chairperson:
Assistant Secretary for Maritime of the DOTr
Vice Chairperson:
Deputy Administrator for Operations of the MARINA
Representatives from the following agencies:
a. Department of Foreign Affairs;
b. Philippine Coast Guard;
c. Philippine Ports Authority;
d. Cebu Port Authority;
e. Commission on Higher Education;
f. National Mapping and Resource Information
g. Environmental Management Bureau of the
Department of Environment and
h. Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources of the
Department of Agriculture;
i. Office for Transportation Security of the DOTr; and
j. Philippine National Police Maritime Group.
The TWG shall undertake the following:
a. Develop and submit to the Council an NWP on the implementation of the
relevant IMO instruments which shall include the delineation of roles and
responsibilities, institutional arrangements, and identification of resource
requirements;
b. Develop a monitoring mechanism to assess the progress of implementation of
IMO instruments;
c. Perform such functions as may be directed by the Council.

Secretariat. The Overseas Shipping Service of the MARINA shall serve
as the Secretariat of the Council. It shall coordinate with relevant agencies on the status

of the Council's plans and programs, and provide updates to the Council on the
implementation of the NWP.

Reportorial Requirement. The DOT shall submit to the Office of the
President, through the Office of the Executive Secretary, annual reports on the
implementation of this Order.

Agency Support. All other government offices and agencies are
directed to render such prompt and necessary assistance, consistent with their respective
mandates, to fully implement the provisions of this Order.

Funding. The initial funding requirements for the implementation of
this Order shall be charged against sources to be identified by the Department of Budget
and Management. The necessary funding for succeeding years shall be incorporated in
the annual budget proposals of the member-agencies through the General Appropriations

Separability. If any provision of this Order is declared invalid or
unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid and
subsisting.

Repeal. All executive orders, rules and regulations, and other
issuances or parts thereof which are inconsistent with this Order are hereby revoked,
amended or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of July in the year of Our Lord, Two
Thousand and Nineteen.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
